product_metadata.title: J World New York Lola Lunch Tote, Love Purple, One Size
features: Tote Lunch Box — This cute lunch bag for women lets you carry lunch to work in style—a fashion lunch box that can easily be mistaken for a handbag!
Insulated — High density insulation and a heat reflective silver lining keeps your food cold (or hot) in this thermal lunch bag
Packs Typical Lunch — Cooler lunch bag holds a 12-16 oz drink, a yogurt cup, a fruit cup, a small cottage cheese container, an apple, and 2 frozen gel packs
Exterior Pocket — Zipper pocket is perfect for carrying cutlery, cell phone, or keys

Carry Handles — Carry in your hand or on your elbow to free your hands. For a soft insulated lunch bag designed to carry on your shoulder, search for J World New York Casey” or "J World New York Cody"
Fits In Fridge — The narrow profile of this slim lunch box readily fits into a crowded refrigerator at work. For a wider lunch tote, search for “J World New York Casey" or "J World New York Cara"
Durable — High-quality collapsible lunch bag is made from tear resistant 600D polyester fabric with strong zippers for long-lasting durability. Water resistant lining wipes clean
Bottle Bag — Also functions as a cold bag for baby bottles or as a drink cooler bag. Fits four 8-oz. baby bottles or three 16-oz drinks. Measures 10 x 9 x 6 inches (8.8 liters)
Our Promise — At J World New York, we stand behind our products 100%. If you have any issues with this lunch box purse, we will make things right
description: Bold patterns and sophisticated designs are J World New York’s Unique features. Inspired by the New York City Lifestyle, each collection accommodates different needs and looks for active and fashion conscious people.
